name: UN OCHA ReliefWeb
desc: OCHA's leading humanitarian information service: situation reports, updates, maps, jobs for crises worldwide.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX)
desc: OCHA's open platform for sharing and finding humanitarian data across crises and countries.

name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)
desc: IOM system tracking and monitoring displacement and population mobility for IDPs and migrants.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder
desc: UNHCR official statistics on refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs and stateless persons by country and year.

name: ACAPS
desc: Independent analysis of humanitarian crises: severity, risk and needs assessments for decision-makers.

name: FEWS NET
desc: USAID-funded famine early warning on acute food insecurity driven by climate, conflict and markets.

name: INFORM Risk Index
desc: EC JRC open global risk index for humanitarian crises and disasters; INFORM Risk, Severity and Warning.

name: WHO Health Emergencies
desc: WHO emergencies programme: disease outbreak news, situation reports and health crisis surveillance.

name: FAO GIEWS
desc: FAO Global Information and Early Warning System on food, monitoring supply/demand and emerging shortages.

name: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification)
desc: Multi-partner standard classifying acute and chronic food insecurity and famine by phase.

name: Insecurity Insight
desc: H2H org tracking attacks on aid workers, health care and education in conflict and disaster zones.

name: Aid Worker Security Database (AWSD)
desc: Humanitarian Outcomes' global record of major security incidents against aid workers since 1997.

name: IDMC (Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre)
desc: Leading source of data and analysis on internal displacement from conflict, violence and disasters.

name: Danish Refugee Council (DRC)
desc: Major humanitarian NGO protecting displaced people; runs displacement forecasting and Foresight.

name: Mixed Migration Centre (MMC)
desc: DRC-hosted knowledge centre on mixed migration; 4Mi migrant survey data, research and analysis.

name: ICRC (International Committee of the Red Cross)
desc: Neutral humanitarian protection and assistance in armed conflict; IHL guidance and field operations.

name: GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System)
desc: UN-EC framework issuing real-time alerts on earthquakes, cyclones, floods, droughts and volcanoes.

name: OCHA Global Humanitarian Overview / Humanitarian Action
desc: OCHA platform for the Global Humanitarian Overview, appeals, response plans and needs data.

name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data)
desc: Real-time disaggregated data on political violence and protest events in every country worldwide.

name: UNHCR Emergency Handbook
desc: UNHCR field guide to agile, effective, community-based emergency response and preparedness.

name: WFP HungerMap LIVE
desc: WFP near-real-time global hunger monitoring combining food security, weather and conflict data.

name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
desc: Open mapping of vulnerable and crisis-affected areas to support disaster response and humanitarian aid.
